_comment: Questions a real customer would type into ChatGPT. {where} becomes e.g. 'Chamberí (Madrid)' or 'Madrid'. Every question in a sector must fit the same kind of business, so the 10 targets are comparable. 'generic' words are stripped before matching business names, so 'Clínica Dental Sonrisas' and 'Sonrisas' count as the same business.
